title: Inconsistent serde feature propagation in pkix-ct
description: pkix-ct has three features that pull in serde: log-list-json (which deps serde, serde_json, base64) and the parent log-list. However, there is no standalone serde feature flag for enabling Serialize/Deserialize on the crate's public Error type. Every other crate in the workspace that supports serde on its Error type does so via a dedicated serde Cargo feature. pkix-ct pulls serde in only for JSON log-list parsing, not for error-type serialization. A caller who wants to cache pkix_ct::Error values cannot opt into serde on Error without also pulling in serde_json and base64. The feature name serde that callers expect from workspace convention is absent from pkix-ct's Cargo.toml. Locations: /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-ct/Cargo.toml, /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-ct/src/lib.rs line 67.
